first_red.projection_reference: The Link-13 receipt projected ordinary text ending at 0xb47a, leaving seven bytes before 0xb481. The real Link-14 runtime-bootstrap link ended at 0xb484 instead, invalidating that projection by ten bytes and producing a three-byte overlap.
first_red.meaning: The historical handoff position and fixed facade leave no unallocated byte between the 289-byte handoff and 0xb5a2. At least three bytes must leave the ordinary-text interval before a fresh link can be authorized; moving or overlapping the pinned handoff would violate the accepted layout contract.

recommended_next_decision.required_effect: Remove or relocate at least three real bytes from the ordinary-text interval below 0xb481 while preserving the pinned handoff, facade and all ownership boundaries.
not_authorized: overlap the handoff with ordinary text or the fixed facade
rerun Link 14 with an unreviewed micro-shrink
weaken a linker assertion or structural gate
recommended_next_decision.authorization: Any concrete relocation or shrink and any fresh substitution link require review.

claim_limit: Receipt-less diagnostic first-red only. The map proves the three-byte collision and the attempted Link-14 placements; it proves no runtime bootstrap, product link, capacity, fixed-facade closure, pre-ownership separation, one-truth, KERNAL freedom, hardware behavior or promotion claim.
